assets.description: Phase 2 target dummy. Base at origin, up +Y, faces -Z. Concentric plate on a post, ~1.8 m tall. Node `plate` is coloured by the client to show hit/reset state.

Wall segment. Unit box, base at origin, up +Y, scaled by the client to the collider's half-extents. assets.description: Dropped loot. assets.description: Phase 12 iron ore node. Base at origin, up +Y, faces -Z (the tallest chunk sits toward -Z). Four angular rock chunks, ~1.45 m wide, 1.0 m tall, dark grey with rust-orange facets for the iron streaks; the client scales it 0.6 and darkens it when depleted.

Phase 12 copper ore node. Base at origin, up +Y, faces -Z. Three angular rock chunks in a different arrangement from the iron node, ~1.25 m wide, 0.96 m tall, dark rock with green-teal facets for the copper streaks.

Phase 12 salvage wreck. Base at origin, up +Y, faces -Z: a broken hull panel ~2.4 m long and 0.96 m tall leaning back (+Z) with four ribs and a scorched band on its -Z face, a broken shard at the +X end, a snapped strut at the -X end and a scrap plate on the ground in front.

Phase 12 workbench (npc.workbench). Base at origin, up +Y, faces -Z: a 1.6 x 0.7 m steel slab at 0.9 m on two dark-blue block legs with a shelf, a vise block at the +X end on the -Z edge, and a tool rack post with a pegged bar at the -X end rising to 1.24 m.

Phase 12 hand drill, the TOOL slot item that opens iron ore nodes. Held like weapon.pulse: -Z forward, pistol grip bottoming out at y=0, 0.49 m long and 0.13 m tall; yellow body, dark grip and motor cap, steel chuck and tapered bit. Mount nodes `grip` (where the right hand holds it) and `muzzle` (the bit tip at the -Z end).

Phase 12 plasma cutter, the TOOL slot item that opens wrecks. Held like weapon.pulse: -Z forward, rear grip bottoming out at y=0, 0.39 m long and 0.16 m tall; orange boxy body, dark side handle and gas cell on top, steel collar and short tapered nozzle. Mount nodes `grip` (where the right hand holds it) and `muzzle` (the nozzle tip at the -Z end).
